title: Why are we all connecting this now?
content: I am super curious honestly. I was talking to my partner a few months ago about how I always dream about the same places. How I am convinced it is a part of a reality. He doesn't dream the same, he said he never dreams in the same space. Because he doesn't he thinks this is a false connection we are all having, and I can't convince him otherwise. I know that this is very real, and I'm glad connections are being made. My biggest question is why now? I have been dreaming about mall world for years and years. How are we all connecting this now and why? Any ideas or theories are welcome.
